post.description: The signature is checked through the gateway (400 `PAYMENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID`, also for another order’s result). Not final: a valid result makes the payment `PENDING` at most; only the gateway’s verified notice makes it `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED`, so poll the booking’s `paymentStatus`. Repeating it changes nothing.

For the payment gateway only. The signature over the exact body is verified before anything else, and a refused call is stored nowhere; `:provider` is the configured gateway (`mock` in this build). A verified event is stored once (unique per provider event ID) and applied in the same transaction before the 200: a repeated delivery is acknowledged and changes nothing. Outcomes only move a payment forward (a failure after a success is ignored); a success never changes the booking’s status, only its `paymentStatus`; a success for a closed or already-paid booking is recorded and flagged for operations. An event for an unknown order is stored and acknowledged. Limited per address (120 a minute by default, `RATE_LIMIT_WEBHOOK_PER_MINUTE`; 429 `RATE_LIMITED`).

info.title: Flyviman API
info.description:
Aviation booking platform API. Conventions: docs/api/api-design.md.

**Envelope.** Every success is `{ data, meta }` (schema `EnvelopeDto`): each route below documents only its `data`. `meta` (`ResponseMetaDto`) holds `requestId`, and on list routes `page`, `pageSize` and `total`; a list route documented as an array answers with that array in `data`.

**Errors.** Every error is `{ error: { code, message, details, requestId } }` (schema `ErrorEnvelopeDto`), with the HTTP status; clients switch on `code`.

email.description: Register with email and password. Send this or `phone`.

phone.description: Register with a mobile number and one-time code. E.164.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true: the terms and the privacy policy are accepted.

verificationId.description: Identifies this attempt. Send it back with the code to verify.

destination.description: Where the code was sent, partly hidden.

phone.description: Sign in a customer registered with this number.

verificationId.description: Send a fresh code for this open attempt instead.

reason.description: Why the status is being changed. Audited.

body.description: Plain text with blank lines between paragraphs.

published.description: Publish now. Default false: saved as a draft.
true publishes (or keeps it published); false unpublishes.

versionCount.description: Versions published so far, the current one included.

body.description: Plain text with blank lines between paragraphs.

baseVersion.description: The `versionCount` the editor loaded (0 for a policy with no version). Required. When another version has been published since, 409 `CONTENT_VERSION_CONFLICT` and nothing is written.

placeholders.description: Placeholders the built-in wording uses. A change must keep every one and may add none.

stored.description: False while no row is stored and the built-in text applies.

profile.description: Present for customers; null for operator and internal users.

version.description: Required for BOOKING_CONDITIONS and MARKETING. Ignored for TERMS and PRIVACY, which always record the published version.

aircraftIds.description: Assigned aircraft; empty when allAircraft is true.

displayName.description: Trading name, or the legal name if none.

reviewNote.description: The reason given when the application was rejected or suspended.

missing.description: What is still needed before the application can be submitted. Empty when it is complete.

end.description: Local time, HH:MM (24 h). Before `start` spans midnight.

operatingHours.description: When the aircraft may depart and arrive, in the local time of each location.

excludedLocationIds.description: Locations the aircraft does not fly to or from.
